text: Binary per-row measure from the `argument` column only (the OP's current argument text, including marked edits): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly acknowledges potential counterpoints, objections, counterarguments or opposing views to their own position (e.g. noting what others might object, or conceding a possible opposing consideration); 0 if no such explicit acknowledgment appears. Does not count quotations or opponents' positions the OP doesn't raise or adopt as a possible counterpoint, nor generic uncertainty without reference to a counterpoint. Entirely excludes as evidence any view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the view changed (these must not produce a 1); generic discussion of platform/delta rules is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible if relevant. Does not reconstruct an initial post version. Returns null if the argument is missing or malformed.
